description: This is a unit test class for the PurgeEntities command in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.common.purge package. It tests immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and setup for the PurgeEntities command, which is part of a signaling framework to purge entities identified by IDs and type.

classes.name: PurgeEntitiesTest
classes.description: Unit test for the PurgeEntities class, verifying immutability, JSON conversion, and equality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the PurgeEntities instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies the immutability of the PurgeEntities class and certain fields.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that creating a PurgeEntities object from JSON yields the expected object.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the PurgeEntities object serializes to the expected JSON.
